nodes.text: While the shrine burns, this ground is ours. Fall out there and you wake here, by its candles - the living, anyway.
Risen, mostly. Bone Knights along the east road. Robbers who were robbers before they died, and the warlocks who raised them.
Put six Risen back in the ground. Holy water for your trouble.
I dig by day and sell by night. Stand on the planks by my table and see what the dead left me.
Never better. Nobody stays buried round here.
Two gates, one fence and whoever answers the bell. When it tolls, the Ossuary Lord sends all he has.
The night goes black and they come in waves, more for every blade on the wall. Hold both gates until the Lord himself walks out of the trees.
Thin them out. Three Bone Knights off the east road, and there is gold in it.
